name: daily_brief_deploys_v1
description: Brief Status/Pace: governed aegis:DeploymentEvent records in two explicit camayoc monthly deployment window graphs (current and previous month) at or after a client-supplied UTC time. Bounded LIMIT 101; overflow is UNKNOWN. Merges, releases and closes have no in-budget governed source and are not read.
template:
PREFIX a: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/>
SELECT ?e ?t ?outcome ?service ?artifact ?env WHERE { VALUES ?g { <{monthNow}> <{monthPrev}> } GRAPH ?g { ?e a a:DeploymentEvent ; a:occurredAt ?t ; a:deploymentOutcome ?outcome . FILTER(STR(?t) >= '{since}') OPTIONAL { ?e a:deployedService ?service } OPTIONAL { ?e a:artifactId ?artifact } OPTIONAL { ?e a:environment ?env } } } ORDER BY DESC(?t) ?e LIMIT 101
scope: deployments in the last 24 hours, up to 100; overflow is UNKNOWN
